record.paper_title: Open Problems on Open Algebraic Varieties (Montreal 1994 Problems)
record.original_question: What is the maximal number of cusps that a rational cuspidal plane curve can have?

evidence.quote: PROBLEM 2. Find the maximal number of cusps among all the rational cuspi dal plane curves.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A rational cuspidal plane curve is an irreducible curve $C \subset \mathbb{P}^2_{\mathbb{C}}$ that is rational (its normalization is $\mathbb{P}^1$) and whose only singularities are cusps, i.e. locally irreducible singular points (unibranch singularities). Let $N$ denote the supremum, taken over all rational cuspidal plane curves $C$, of the number of cusps (singular points) of $C$.

Determine $N$: what is the maximal possible number of cusps on a rational cuspidal plane curve?
artifact.status_search_result: The exact maximum is not known. Tono proved that a rational cuspidal plane curve has at most 8 cusps, and Orevkov (2017) gave a remark/improvement on Tono's theorem. The largest number of cusps realized by known examples is 4, and it is widely conjectured (Piontkowski and others) that 4 is the true maximum, but this remains unproven. Hence the problem is partially solved with an upper bound of 8 and conjectural value 4.

status_evidence.title: On the Number of the Cusps of Rational Cuspidal Plane Curves (Piontkowski)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the number of cusps on rational cuspidal plane curves; known examples have at most 4 cusps.
status_evidence.claim: Best known examples of rational cuspidal plane curves have 4 cusps; conjecturally this is maximal.

status_evidence.title: Remark on Tono's theorem about cuspidal curves (Orevkov, 2017)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses and refines Tono's theorem bounding the number of cusps of a rational cuspidal plane curve.
status_evidence.claim: Tono established an upper bound (at most 8) for the number of cusps on a rational cuspidal plane curve.

status_evidence.title: Rational Cuspidal Curves (Moe thesis)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys results on rational cuspidal plane curves and the cusp-count problem.
status_evidence.claim: The exact maximal number of cusps of a rational cuspidal plane curve is still an open problem.
